subtitle: Turn one recording into useful content with a repeatable workflow.

steps.title: Collect the source
steps.description: Pull the recording, transcript, slides and offer into one working brief.

steps.title: Find the strongest ideas
steps.description: Mark the claims, stories and examples that can stand alone without extra context.

steps.title: Match ideas to formats
steps.description: Assign each useful idea to the post, clip, email or visual it suits best.

steps.title: Create the asset batch
steps.description: Write and package the selected formats with one consistent point of view.

steps.title: Ship and learn weekly
steps.description: Publish the batch, collect audience signals and feed the lessons into the next run.

caption: One webinar can become more than one post. The useful part is not cutting the same recording into random pieces. It is finding the strongest ideas, matching each one to the right format, and using the response to improve the next batch. This infographic shows the five-step content engine. Save it for your next recording.
